out.first: 1I was a king who came to Caesarea with Bernice to greet Festus.
1I was among the herdmen of Tekoa.
1I was a Jew born at Alexandria.
1I was one of the twelve spies.
1The LORD raised me up as a deliverer of Israel; I was a Benjamite.
1I was a Pharisee and a doctor of the law.
1I was the wife of Heber the Kenite.
